local.title: Connect to your G1 LAN API
local.description: Experimental read-only integration. Requires an existing local API key, not your Daikin cloud password.

cloud.title: Connect Daikin Control cloud
cloud.description: Use your DAIKIN Control app credentials. Enabling controls allows changes to heating and hot water settings. A cloud confirmation does not prove sensor freshness. Credentials are stored in Home Assistant private configuration.
